Moreover, the incident involved multiple people inciting and participating in a public disturbance that blocked traffic for an hour, which matches the offense of disturbing public order by a group (聚众扰乱社会秩序). Therefore, the applicable crimes are illegal occupation of farmland, intentional injury, and group disturbance of public order.",
